context: A regional hotel chain needs online room booking with controlled pricing, availability, cancellation, check-in, notifications, permissions, and peak-load behavior.

requirements.text: Guests must be able to search available rooms by check-in date, check-out date, and occupancy.
The system must prevent two confirmed bookings from using the same room for overlapping dates.
Room prices must be calculated from the active seasonal rate for every night of the stay.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how multi-night prices are calculated.
requirements.condition: using each night's active seasonal rate

requirements.text: Bookings above ten million VND require a 30 percent deposit before confirmation.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask about deposits and high-value bookings.
requirements.condition: 30 percent when total exceeds ten million VND

requirements.text: Guests may cancel without charge until 48 hours before check-in.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask about cancellation deadlines and fees.
requirements.condition: without charge until 48 hours before check-in

requirements.text: When a room type is sold out, guests should be able to join a waitlist.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask what happens when rooms are sold out.
requirements.condition: when room type is sold out

requirements.text: Reception staff must verify the lead guest's identity before completing check-in.
Only revenue managers may edit seasonal room rates.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask who may change room prices.

requirements.text: The system should email a booking confirmation containing dates, room type, price, and cancellation policy.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask what confirmation the guest receives.

requirements.text: The booking service must support 300 concurrent searches with a response time below three seconds.
